Load data & libraries.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
#set working directory here:
setwd("~/Desktop")
Sys.setlocale("LC_ALL", "C")
library(tidyverse)
rep <- read_csv("rep_discern_coefs_FULL.csv")
dem <- read_csv("dem_discern_coefs_FULL.csv")
mod <- read_csv("mod_coefs_FULL.csv")
simple <- read_csv("simpdiscern_coefs_FULL.csv")

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(lme4)
library(MASS)
library(ggeffects)
library(lmerTest)
library(mediation)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(corrr)
library(corrplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(nlme)
library(afex)
library(lmerTest)
library(MuMIn)
library(sjstats)
library(psych)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(fixest)
library(tm)
library(vader)
library(pscl)
```


Mod P-values.
```{r}
table(mod$p<.05)
table(mod$Coef>0)

table(mod$p<.01)
table(rep$p<.01)

max(rep$p)
min(rep$Coef)
min(rep$p)
max(rep$Coef)

max(dem$p)
min(dem$Coef)
min(dem$p)
max(dem$Coef)
```


P plots. [note: these are not p-curves, since p-values are from highly overlapping data & analyses]

Histograms.
```{r}
ggplot(rep, aes(x=p))+geom_histogram(fill="red", bins=20)+xlim(-0.005, 0.05)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+ scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+xlab("p-values (Republican Discernment)")+ylab("Count")
```

```{r}
ggplot(dem, aes(x=p))+geom_histogram(fill="blue", bins=20)+xlim(-0.005, 0.05)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+ scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+xlab("p-values (Democrat Discernment)")+ylab("Count")
```

```{r}
ggplot(mod, aes(x=p))+geom_histogram(fill="purple", bins=20)+xlim(-0.005, 1)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+ scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+xlab("p-values (Partisan Moderation of Discernment)")+ylab("Count")
```

Line plots.
```{r}
rep_p <- rep$p
dem_p <- dem$p
mod_p <- mod$p

p_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(rep_p, dem_p, mod_p))

p_df$mod_p2 <- ifelse(p_df$mod_p>=.15,.15,p_df$mod_p)

p_df_long <- gather(p_df, analysis, p, rep_p:mod_p2)

p_df_long <- p_df_long %>% filter(analysis != "mod_p")

p_df_long$analysis <- factor(p_df_long$analysis, levels=c("rep_p", "dem_p", "mod_p2"))
```

Combined histogram.
```{r}
ggplot(p_df_long, aes(x=p, fill=analysis))+geom_histogram(color = "black", position = "dodge", binwidth = 0.01)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("P-values")+ylab("Count")+scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,.15), labels=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,"0.15+"))+scale_fill_manual("", labels=c("Republican Discernment", "Democrat Discernment", "Moderation"), values=c("red", "blue", "gold3"))+ggtitle("Histogram of P-values")
```

Main Line Plot.
```{r}
ggplot(p_df_long, aes(x=p, group=analysis, color=analysis))+geom_freqpoly(size=1.5, alpha=0.7)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("P-values")+ylab("Count")+ scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,.15), breaks=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,.15), labels=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,"0.15+"))+scale_color_manual("", labels=c("Rep. Discernment", "Dem. Discernment", "Moderation"), values=c("red", "blue", "purple"))+ggtitle("P-value Distributions")
```

Line plot: only eval + importance treatments (all partisanship operationalizations).
```{r}
rep2 <- rep %>% filter(Treatment == "Evaluation + Importance")
dem2 <- dem %>% filter(Treatment == "Evaluation + Importance")
mod2 <- mod %>% filter(Treatment == "Evaluation + Importance")

rep_p <- rep2$p
dem_p <- dem2$p
mod_p <- mod2$p

p_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(rep_p, dem_p, mod_p))

p_df$mod_p2 <- ifelse(p_df$mod_p>=.15,.15,p_df$mod_p)

p_df_long <- gather(p_df, analysis, p, rep_p:mod_p2)

p_df_long <- p_df_long %>% filter(analysis != "mod_p")

p_df_long$analysis <- factor(p_df_long$analysis, levels=c("rep_p", "dem_p", "mod_p2"))
```

```{r}
ggplot(p_df_long, aes(x=p, group=analysis, color=analysis))+geom_freqpoly(size=1.5, alpha=0.7)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("P-values")+ylab("Count")+ scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,.15), breaks=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,.15), labels=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,"0.15+"))+scale_color_manual("", labels=c("Rep. Discernment", "Dem. Discernment", "Moderation"), values=c("red", "blue", "purple"))+ggtitle("P-value Distributions")
```

```{r}
ggplot(p_df_long2, aes(x=p, group=analysis, color=analysis))+geom_freqpoly(size=1.5, alpha=0.7)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0.05), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("P-values")+ylab("Count")+ scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0))+scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,.15), breaks=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,.15), labels=c(0,.01,.02,.03,.04,.05,.06,.07,.08,.09,.10,.11,.12,.13,.14,"0.15+"))+scale_color_manual("", labels=c("Moderation"), values=c("purple"))+ggtitle("P-value Distributions")
```

Coef Plots.
```{r}
rep$Treatment[rep$Treatment=="Evaluation + Importance"] <- "Evaluation or Importance"
dem$Treatment[dem$Treatment=="Evaluation + Importance"] <- "Evaluation or Importance"
mod$Treatment[mod$Treatment=="Evaluation + Importance"] <- "Evaluation or Importance"
simple$Treatment[simple$Treatment=="Evaluation + Importance"] <- "Evaluation or Importance"
```


```{r}
rep$Treatment <- factor(rep$Treatment, levels=c("Multiple Interventions", "Evaluation or Importance", "Evaluation", "No Norms or Tips", "No Tips", "No Norms", "All"))

dem$Treatment <- factor(dem$Treatment, levels=c("Multiple Interventions", "Evaluation or Importance", "Evaluation", "No Norms or Tips", "No Tips", "No Norms", "All"))

mod$Treatment <- factor(mod$Treatment, levels=c("Multiple Interventions", "Evaluation or Importance", "Evaluation", "No Norms or Tips", "No Tips", "No Norms", "All"))

simple$Treatment <- factor(simple$Treatment, levels=c("Multiple Interventions", "Evaluation or Importance", "Evaluation", "No Norms or Tips", "No Tips", "No Norms", "All"))

rep$CI <- rep$SE*qnorm(0.975)
dem$CI <- dem$SE*qnorm(0.975)
mod$CI <- mod$SE*qnorm(0.975)
simple$CI <- simple$SE*qnorm(0.975)
```

Plots.
```{r}
ggplot(rep, aes(x=Coef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=Coef-CI, xmax=Coef+CI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+xlim(-0.01, 0.1)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("Acc Prompt on Republican Discernment")
```

```{r}
ggplot(dem, aes(x=Coef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=Coef-CI, xmax=Coef+CI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+xlim(-0.01, 0.1)+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("Acc Prompt on Democrat Discernment")
```

```{r}
ggplot(mod, aes(x=Coef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=Coef-CI, xmax=Coef+CI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlim(-0.06, 0.06)+xlab("Partisan Moderation of Acc Prompt on Discernment")
```

```{r}
ggplot(simple, aes(x=Coef, y=Treatment, color=Partisanship, group=Partisanship, shape=Exclude_NonPoliticalNewsSharers))+
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin=Coef-CI, xmax=Coef+CI), position=position_dodge2(width = 0.5, padding=0.5))+scale_color_manual(values=c("red", "orange", "green", "blue", "purple"))+geom_vline(aes(xintercept=0), color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlab("Partisan Moderation of Discernment (control)")
```

Scatterplot of Effects.
```{r}
repcoef <- rep$Coef
demcoef <- dem$Coef
treat <- as.character(rep$Treatment)

coef_df <- as.data.frame(cbind(repcoef, demcoef, treat))

coef_df$repcoef <- as.numeric(coef_df$repcoef)
coef_df$demcoef <- as.numeric(coef_df$demcoef)
```

```{r}
ggplot(coef_df, aes(x=repcoef, y=demcoef, group=treat, color=treat))+geom_point()+geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, color="black", linetype="dashed", size=1)+theme_classic()+xlim(0,0.08)+ylim(0,0.08)+xlab("Republican Discernment Coefficients")+ylab("Democrat Discernment Coefficients")+ggtitle("Republican vs Democrat Discernment Coefficients")+ labs(color = "Treatment")
```
